title: McKay correspondence for linearly reductive finite group schemes in positive characteristic
summary: We obtain a motivic and a cohomological McKay correspondence for finite linearly reductive group schemes in arbitrary characteristic. In particular, we prove that if $V$ is a finite dimensional vector space and $G$ is a finite linearly reductive subgroup scheme of $\mathrm{SL}(V)$, then the Euler number of any crepant resolution of $V/G$ is equal to the number of irreducible algebraic representations of $G$.
